verdict.rationale: Fern is a documentation platform, so linting content against a style guide is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no style-guide linting. The CLI validates API definitions rather than prose against a style guide. Fern Agent automations review reader feedback and analytics, which is an adjacent feature, not pre-publish style checks.

support.subject: As a technical writer, automated checks lint my content against a style guide and flag issues before they publish
